notes: Created a two-phase implementation plan for the TitleInteraction multi-touch intercept bug. Phase 1 adds the missing _multiTouchGestureActive guard to _onPointerMove (mirroring the existing guard in _onPointerDown). Phase 2 adds a cancelPendingInteraction() method to TitleInteraction and wires it via an optional onGestureStart callback in MultiTouchHandler to clear stale pending state when a gesture begins. Plan includes 25+ BDD scenarios across user behavior, component behavior, pure function, and integration levels. Identified key design decisions: guard applies to ALL _onPointerMove processing (including hover), cancelPendingInteraction only clears pending state (not active interaction), and onGestureStart is optional for backward compatibility. Read TitleInteraction.js (474 lines), MultiTouchHandler.js (429 lines), createCollageLifecycle.js (handler wiring), and all three existing test files to understand patterns and integration points.
